text: 🎬 Street Fighter won its weekend, but a sequel isn't a lock Kitao Sakurai 's 'Street Fighter' opened at No. 1 with $31 million domestic and $51.1 million worldwide. That is level with 'Masters of the Universe' and short of 'Mortal Kombat II' , which opened at $38.5 million. A start that size gets a sequel talked about, not signed. The budget, the overseas run and the film's second-weekend drop will decide it, and franchise fighting games have a bad record with follow-ups. Paramount's cast leans on Andrew Koji as Ryu, Noah Centineo as Ken, Callina Liang as Chun-Li, plus Jason Momoa and Roman Reigns. ✈️ Add to watchlist

🎬 Affleck's Batman would have buried Jim Gordon Joe Manganiello , who played Deathstroke, says the canceled Ben Affleck Batman movie would have killed Commissioner Gordon. It's a single interview anecdote, so treat it as color and not as a confirmed plot. Still, the choice fits. Gordon is Batman's last link to a Gotham that trusts anyone, and killing him would have pushed this older, battered Bruce toward the bleak endgame that 'Justice League' only hinted at. It's a bold swing, and DC never got to show it. Manganiello's Deathstroke was last seen in a post-credits scene.

🎬 'Animals' is now Netflix's biggest streaming hit Ben Affleck directs and co-stars in an R-rated, 108-minute thriller that, per /Film, has topped Netflix's streaming numbers. It's a lean, adult genre piece, with no franchise and no multiverse. Kerry Washington follows 'Wake Up Dead Man' with another Netflix win. Two hits in a row make her one of the platform's most dependable faces. Affleck as director-for-hire, delivering tight thrillers at a streamer's pace, suits him better than another capes-and-cowls detour. Mid-budget grown-up movies didn't die. They moved to Netflix. ✈️ Add to watchlist
